headline: Spain nick it, while Belgium wobble and the draws bite
text: Spain (Grandad) have the best of the recent lot, nicking a 2-1 win over Belgium (Vicki). The two draws meant Argentina (Nana) v Switzerland (Jack) and Norway (Max) v England (Alex) both finished level, so no real damage done there, just a bit of shrugging. Overall, Max is still top of the tree on 30 points, with Grandad next on 26. At the other end, Sofia is bottom on 10, with Christopher not far ahead on 11. A tidy little shake-up, but nothing too dramatic — yet.
